objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Ask the DNS server for the whole vulhub.org zone and find the flag in its records.
hints: The server is authoritative for vulhub.org and does not restrict who may request a zone transfer.
A zone transfer is a query of type AXFR over TCP. Read every record type that comes back, not only the A records.

steps.title: Name the query
steps.prompt: Which DNS query type asks for a full copy of a zone? (acronym)

steps.title: Name the transport
steps.prompt: Over which transport protocol does a zone transfer run?

steps.title: Identify the server
steps.prompt: Which DNS server software answers? (product name)

steps.title: Find the flag
steps.prompt: Which record type holds the flag?
